text: (1) Non-Chinese citizens who are in good physical and mental health (free from infectious diseases and physical or mental disorders that affect normal study) and have good conduct. 2) Educational Requirements: Applicants for undergraduate programs must have a high school diploma. (III) Language Requirements: Applicants for courses taught in English, except those whose native language is English, are required to provide proof of their English proficiency (such as TOEFL/IELTS/DUOLINGUO) or proof of previous English-language courses they have taken. (TOEFL ITP scores are not accepted.) 2. Students applying for the Chinese language program are required to submit a certificate of proficiency in the Chinese language at the HSK 4 level or above, or proof of having completed a previous stage of the Chinese language course. (4) Age requirement: For those applying to pursue a bachelor's degree, the age should generally not exceed 25 years old.
